title: US-short §8 宏观集群集中度 (macro_cluster pseudo-diversification gate) governance — const-pins the warning-level vocab + the v1 soft-effect/no-hard-cap policy + the high-warning effects, with the cluster TAG vocab explicitly open
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §8 macro_cluster pseudo-diversification back-gate: the macro_cluster_warning_level vocab {none, elevated, high} (== action_table), the four governed fields, the v1 policy (NO hard cap — thresholds unproven — only soft effect + report banner), and the high-warning effects (risk_tag + lower action_confidence + shrink model_position_size as ONE 削减叠法 step-③ risk discount folded into take-harshest-single with NO extra compounding + record macro_cluster_size_adjustment + report banner). The macro_cluster TAG vocabulary is OPEN/illustrative (如 ai_complex / rates_sensitive / commodity / defensive …), const `macro_cluster_vocab_is_open=true`, so a future consumer must not treat it as a closed enum. Hard cluster-exposure cap is forward-routed to §13.1 #31, not set in v1. draft-07 cannot express: warning_level == action_table, fields ⊆ action_table columns, provenance in §8, and hard_cap_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

warning_levels.description: §8 macro_cluster_warning_level vocab, byte-faithful (frac 分档 = §13 #31); == action_table macro_cluster_warning_level.

macro_cluster_fields.description: §8 the four governed macro_cluster fields (⊆ action_table columns).

macro_cluster_vocab_is_open.description: §8 macro_cluster TAG vocab is illustrative/open (如 … …) — NOT a closed enum; a consumer must not reject unseen cluster tags.

v1_policy.description: §8 v1 — NO hard cap (thresholds unproven), only soft effect + report banner.

high_warning_effects.description: §8 warning_level=high effects — soft only; the size shrink is ONE 削减叠法 step-③ discount (take-harshest-single, no extra compounding).

hard_cap_calibration_item_id.description: §8 hard cluster-exposure cap = forward → §13.1 #31 (macro_cluster 定义 + warning_level 分档 + 集群暴露硬上限).
